# Ygg operating plane

Load the registered **yggterm** skill as the progressive entry point, then
load only the component needed for the task. Discover skills through
`ygg ynpm skills list` and `ygg ynpm skills info <name>`.

Use the shared Ygg memory system across harnesses. Before campaign recall
or handover, run `ygg memory sync --harness <actual-harness> --ns=<area>`,
inspect status/diff in that area, and open its NOW.md when present. Preserve
explicit conflicts and unavailable evidence. Never copy native credential,
session, database or lock files as a memory synchronization shortcut.

Before escalating a login or credential-access failure, follow the configured
credential recovery protocol through the root skill and operator policy. An
expired service session alone is not evidence that the owner must sign in.
Use only authorized recovery paths, verify the requested operation, and keep
secrets out of argv, transcripts and source. If the protocol or recovery path
is unavailable, report the missing route explicitly instead of inventing one.

Work checkpoints bind the owner's criteria, exact subject, evidence and
open findings. Substantive completion requires independent acceptance by
the editor configured in the active swarm policy. Worker assertions,
process exit and model agreement do not close a finding. Missing evidence,
quota or unavailable review retains the obligation. Verify affected behavior
at the requested surface. Optional quality scores cannot override failed
criteria. A changed rubric must be checked on held-out externally labeled
cases before it is credited as an evaluator improvement.

Composer combines candidate proposal and synthesis. It proposes a scoped
change, contrasts it with a named baseline, retains or applies the exact
authorized revision, reprobes the affected behavior and records the outcome.
No proposal, board post or timer tick alone establishes recovery.

Use `ygg` help and examples for operational discovery. Shared logical work,
profile and evidence identities survive GUI and host changes; host runtime
locks and secrets keep their owner-specific lifecycle. Honor local policy,
owner stop, protected resources and explicit authority boundaries. A generic
seed never arms autonomous execution or changes model/account bindings.
